cards.title: My son has left home – and I feel full of complicated joy
cards.body: A parent reflects on taking their son to university and the mixed emotions of newfound freedom. The experience evokes memories of independence while recognizing the joy and exhilaration of this life transition.

cards.title: Hungry for connection? What we lose when we stop eating together
cards.body: Family mealtimes offer essential pauses where parents and children can sit together, listen, and share stories. These moments create vital connection in our increasingly fragmented daily lives.

cards.title: Location-tracking apps have turned me into a gibbering wreck
cards.body: A parent struggles with the anxiety of not knowing where loved ones are, using location-tracking as 'compassionate surveillance.' The article explores modern parental worry in the digital age.

cards.title: Hopeful Vigilance: What Parents Should Know About GLP-1s
cards.body: GLP-1 prescriptions for teens are surging while research on growth, bone, and mood effects lags behind. Parents need to understand the risks and monitor their teen's health closely.

cards.title: How Teens Can Effectively Respond to Their Insecurity
cards.body: Adolescents often follow the crowd rather than forge their own path. Learning to be independent thinkers helps teens build confidence and resist peer pressure.

cards.title: The 5 Psychological Keys to Freshman Success
cards.body: College freshman year sets the foundation for academic and personal success through involvement, relationships, and healthy habits. Getting involved, prioritizing academics, and building connections are crucial.
